identity.description: Semiparametric survival model: estimates per-feature hazard ratios against an unspecified baseline hazard, handling right-censored time-to-event data natively. Answers WHEN (and relative risk), not just IF.

consumes.note: targetSpec is the (duration, event-indicator) PAIR carried as two columns — the regime that proves the template beyond `plain`

emits.note: log hazard ratios with CIs — the effect-size story

penalizer.note: elastic-net strength; stabilizes under collinearity/few events

invariances.why: coefficients are per-unit log hazard ratios; unscaled features give incomparable magnitudes and slow/unstable convergence
the linear predictor assumes log-linear covariate effects; a monotone transform changes the fit
the partial likelihood has no missing-value handling — rows with NaN covariates are dropped or must be imputed
assumes PROPORTIONAL hazards — the hazard ratio between subjects is constant over time; violation biases the estimate
estimates from the number of EVENTS, not rows; usable at low event counts with a penalizer (wide CIs, stated)
the log-linear form extends risk beyond the observed covariate range (with the usual caution)

featureStats.why: the fraction right-censored is what makes a survival model necessary vs a fixed-window classifier — high censoring is the commit-survival signal
the effective sample size is the number of events; few events flags a penalizer and wide CIs, not a different family
a failed PH assumption (low p on the Schoenfeld test) means the model is misspecified — a gate toward AFT/RSF

modelMetrics.why: the survival-native ranking metric (Harrell's C); the honest scoreboard number a fixed-window AUC cannot express

driver.wrapperNeeds: adapter: (duration,event) columns split from the matrix; predict maps to partial_hazard / survival_function

placementClaims.why: no native NaN handling; unimputed rows are silently dropped, biasing the risk set
log/Yeo-Johnson of skewed covariates improves the log-linear fit
coefficients are per-unit; standardization makes hazard ratios comparable and convergence stable
categoricals must be design-encoded before the partial likelihood
